intro: Tape stayed risk-on into the close with the AI-complex leading and the S&P holding its range. These are quick, next-session leans for perspective — not sized trades. The theme into Wednesday: do the AI-semi names keep their bid, or does a firmer dollar and sticky 10y finally pull the megacaps in? Watch levels, not headlines.

ideas.name: NVIDIA
ideas.idea: Let NVDA prove the breakout above the recent shelf before chasing.
ideas.why: Bulls won the session and the dossier call is HOLD near $211 — constructive but extended into resistance. A clean daily close back above the prior high with volume is a far better entry than buying into the gap; fading momentum here has poor reward-to-risk.
ideas.trigger: Daily close above the recent swing high on above-average volume → momentum continuation.
ideas.risk: A failed breakout that closes back inside the range tends to flush the late longs the next morning.

ideas.name: SK Hynix (000660.KS)
ideas.idea: Play the HBM/AI-memory read-through if NVDA holds.
ideas.why: Hynix is the supply-side twin of the NVIDIA trade — HBM demand is the cleanest derivative of accelerator capex. When NVDA is bid and the dossier carries a BUY, Hynix tends to follow with a lag, and Korea often gaps to catch up to the US AI tape overnight.
ideas.trigger: A green US semis session into the Korea open; confirmation from a firm won.
ideas.risk: A stronger dollar / weak won, or any memory-pricing wobble, breaks the read-through fast.

ideas.name: Bitcoin
ideas.idea: Bitcoin is the risk barometer — let it pick a side of the range first.
ideas.why: BTC near $66-67k is mid-range and trading as a 24/7 proxy for global risk appetite. With no fresh catalyst, range edges are where the edge is: buy support reclaims, fade failed pushes into resistance. The middle is noise.
ideas.trigger: A reclaim of the range high (continuation) or a sweep-and-reclaim of the range low (mean-reversion long).
ideas.risk: A firmer dollar or a risk-off equity session usually drags BTC down first and fastest.

ideas.name: Meta Platforms
ideas.idea: Preferred megacap long if the tape stays risk-on.
ideas.why: Among the megacaps, Meta has the cleanest combination of momentum and a self-funded AI-capex story that the market is rewarding rather than punishing. In a risk-on continuation it tends to lead the cohort; it's the higher-quality expression than chasing NVDA into resistance.
ideas.trigger: Broad-market follow-through (SPX holding its range) with leadership staying in megacap tech.
ideas.risk: A rotation out of growth on a rates/dollar pop hits the highest-beta megacaps first.

ideas.name: Tesla
ideas.idea: Fade strength — the weakest hand in the megacap complex.
ideas.why: Tesla trades more on narrative and positioning than the AI-capex names, and on up days it often lags then gives back. If the broad tape wobbles, it's a high-beta underperformer; a short-term fade of an extended push into resistance has decent odds. This is a tactical lean, not a thesis on the company.
ideas.trigger: A failed push into a prior supply zone / lower-high on the intraday.
ideas.risk: Tesla is squeeze-prone — an unexpected product or delivery headline can rip it through stops.

ideas.name: SpaceX
ideas.idea: Too new to chase — let the post-IPO range form.
ideas.why: SPCX is days off a record IPO with a tiny float and violent two-way swings, so there's no reliable level structure yet. The dossier call is HOLD. The honest move is to watch where the base sets rather than trade the noise; lottery-style entries here are gambling, not edge.
ideas.trigger: A first higher-low forming on the daily after the IPO volatility compresses.
ideas.risk: Thin float means a single large order moves it double-digits — stops are unreliable.

ideas.name: Ethereum
ideas.idea: Higher-beta BTC expression if crypto reclaims its range high.
ideas.why: ETH tends to outrun BTC on the upside in a risk-on crypto leg, so if Bitcoin reclaims its range high, ETH is the higher-beta way to express continuation. It's a follow-the-leader idea — only valid once BTC confirms.
ideas.trigger: BTC reclaiming its range high → rotate into ETH for the beta.
ideas.risk: If BTC rejects, ETH falls faster — beta cuts both ways.
